name: guard-sweep-reports-even-when-it-skips
find:
- name: Say whether an open issue's recorded figures have moved
        if: always()
replace:
- name: Say whether an open issue's recorded figures have moved
        if: always() && steps.ask.outputs.due == 'true'
breaks: the daily monitors run only when the gate says a sweep is due, and since #1428 a sweep runs only on request, so the schedule that exists to run them runs nothing and the repository reads as quiet throughout (#1259, #1428, L106)
